status: 길잃은새, 지금까지 기록 10건 미만 · 2000년 이후 확인된 기록 없음
summary: 우리나라에서는 1914년 인천에서 한 번 채집된 기록만 있는 새이다. 아랫부리에 늘어나는 큰 주머니가 있어 작은 물고기나 새우 따위를 빨아들여 삼킨다. 호숫가나 습지의 갈대밭, 갯벌에 나뭇가지, 수초, 풀로 접시 모양 둥지를 짓고 흰 알을 보통 2~3개 낳는다. 유럽, 아시아, 페르시아만, 카스피해, 몽골, 중국에서 번식하고 중국 남부, 인도 북부, 이집트에서 겨울을 난다.

points.en: huge bill with a large expandable pouch on the lower mandible

art.subject: Dalmatian Pelican (Pelecanus crispus), adult in winter at a Korean coastal wetland: plumage silvery greyish-white overall, with curly, untidy crest feathers on the hindcrown and nape; at rest the black primaries show at the rear of the folded wing; a small bare patch around the eye; iris pale yellow; bill enormous and grey, with a small hooked nail; pouch on the lower mandible orange-yellow (brighter orange-red in early spring); legs and feet leaden-grey.
art.pose: swimming on calm water, scooping small fish into its bill pouch
art.scene: Korean coastal wetland: a lake shore with reedbeds beside tidal mudflats; no people, buildings or text
views: adult winter, side view standing on the shore: silvery greyish-white plumage, curly crest on hindcrown and nape, pale yellow iris, huge grey bill with an orange-yellow pouch on the lower mandible, black primaries at the rear of the folded wing, leaden-grey legs and webbed feet
adult, flight seen from above: head drawn back with the bill resting on the neck, very long broad wings, greyish-white coverts and back, black primaries; head, body and tail in one line
juvenile, side view swimming: greyish-brown head, neck and upperparts, dull whitish underparts, pale pouch, the same huge bill and shape as the adult
art.build: A huge waterbird, 140–178cm, the largest of the pelicans and bulkier than a swan, with a heavy body, thick neck and short legs; swims high on the water. Bill straight and enormous, far longer than the head, with a large expandable pouch on the lower mandible. Legs short and stout, leaden-grey, all four toes webbed. In flight the head is drawn back with the bill on the neck; wings very long and broad; from above the primaries are black, from below the underwing is mostly greyish-white with only the primary tips darker. Tail short and rounded.
avoid: Do not paint pink legs or a pure white body with a pink flush — that is Great White Pelican; Dalmatian is silvery greyish-white with leaden-grey legs.
Do not paint an all-black rear half to the underwing (Great White Pelican); from below only the primary tips are dark.
Do not paint a dark eye on the adult; the iris is pale yellow.
Do not paint a sleek head; adults have curly, shaggy crest feathers on the nape.
